## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：引擎替身检查门禁（`check:engine-double-contract`）新增一条否决：测试里伪造的 MongoDB 原生 `Collection`（带 `insertOne` / `updateOne` 这类只有原生驱动才有的方法）不再被当成 ObjectQL 引擎替身；driver-mongodb 那个为了过门禁被拆成两半的假对象恢复成原本的一个整体。
- 为什么改：这类假对象同时有 `find`、`insertMany`、`findOne`，门禁按方法名把它误判成引擎替身，逼着写测试的人把假对象拆开来绕门禁；它的 `findOne(filter, options)` 根本不收对象名，不是引擎。
- 风险与回滚：否决只在 `findOne` 第一个参数不是对象名时生效，真正的引擎替身照样被抓（自检有对照）；全仓前后读数一致（1230 已钉 / 120 欠账 / 3 豁免），否决只移走这一处、0 个已钉。回滚即撤本 PR，只动门禁脚本和一个测试文件。
- 先看：`scripts/check-engine-double-contract.mjs` 的 `NATIVE_COLLECTION_ONLY_MEMBERS` 和 `isEngineVerbShape` 里新增的否决分支；同文件自检里的 NATIVE COLLECTION 一组；`packages/drivers/driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-declared-column-null-on-write.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-engine-double-contract.mjs --census`，预期末尾一行 `NATIVE_COLLECTION_ONLY_MEMBERS veto moves 1 construct(s); 0 of them pinned`，点名的正是那个 Mongo 测试文件。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #29859

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — gate script only

## What changes

**The false red.** `scripts/check-engine-double-contract.mjs` attributed an object literal to the ObjectQL engine contract by its member names. A fake of MongoDB's native `Collection` declaring `insertOne` / `insertMany` / `updateOne` / `findOne` / `find` held two engine siblings (`find`, `insertMany`) beside `findOne`, so it was discovered as a `findOne` engine double. `isEngineVerbShape` then admitted it on either arity path: a two-parameter `findOne(filter, options)` has a second parameter that is neither an id nor a string, and a short-arity `findOne(filter)` reads `insertMany` as `ENGINE_ONLY_MEMBERS` evidence.

**Which evidence was wrong.** Measured, not assumed: `insertMany` is a real member of the engine class (`ObjectQL.insertMany(object, rows, options)`, `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`), so removing it from `ENGINE_ONLY_MEMBERS` would weaken the engine-side evidence, and it would not have fixed the two-parameter case anyway. What was missing is positive evidence of the OTHER shape. So this adds a fourth arm to the existing evidence architecture:

- `NATIVE_COLLECTION_ONLY_MEMBERS` = `insertOne`, `updateOne`, `deleteOne`, `replaceOne`, `bulkWrite`, `countDocuments`, `estimatedDocumentCount`, `findOneAndUpdate`, `findOneAndDelete`, `findOneAndReplace`. Verified name by name: none is declared in `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, nor on `IDataEngine`, `IDataDriver` or `IScopedObjectRepository` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/`); the same grep's control leg hits `insertMany` in engine.ts and `findOne` in the contracts. `updateMany` / `deleteMany` are left out because `DRIVER_ONLY_MEMBERS` already vetoes them; `distinct` / `createIndex` / `watch` are left out as too generic to mean "Mongo".
- The veto in `isEngineVerbShape` runs right after the scoped-repository veto and under the same object-name guard (`takesObjectNameFirst`): the member is the evidence, and a verb that takes the object name first keeps the literal in scope however many Mongo-named helpers hang off it. So a real engine double cannot leave scan scope by declaring `insertOne`.
- Decided by signature evidence, not by a file name: no path is exempted and no ledger row is added (the baseline is untouched).
- `--census` now ablates this veto on its own, beside the repository veto, so its reach is re-derivable: on this tree it moves exactly 1 construct, 0 of them pinned.

**The bent test, restored.** `packages/drivers/driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-declared-column-null-on-write.test.ts` had been split into `singleRowDb()` / `batchDb()` only so the gate would not see `insertMany` + `find` beside `findOne`. It is one `fakeDb()` again, the natural shape the driver sees (`(driver as any).db = { collection: () => collection }`); the three tests are unchanged.

**Changeset:** none, `skip-changeset`: the diff publishes nothing. `scripts/**` is repo-root tooling, and the driver-mongodb file is a test (`files: ["dist", "README.md", "CHANGELOG.md"]`, tsup entry `src/index.ts`).

## Tests

- Red first, on `main`'s gate (f273c9fe) with the restored test: `node scripts/check-engine-double-contract.mjs` exit 1, `x PINNED [findOne]: packages/drivers/driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-declared-column-null-on-write.test.ts declares 1 engine double(s) whose findOne() does not route through assertEngineFindOnePredicate (line 65)`.
- Green: the same run on HEAD exit 0, `OK — 1230 pinned, 120 in the DEBT ledger, 3 exempt.`
- New self-test battery `The NATIVE COLLECTION, the fourth shape (#29859).` (7 cases, floor pinned at 7, roster floor 34 → 35), as A/B pairs: the five-member native fake is out of scope for the `findOne` slice and the same literal without `insertOne`/`updateOne` is discovered; the same pair at one-parameter `findOne(filter)`; the control the card names, an engine double holding `find`/`insertMany` plus engine members, is still an unpinned `findOne` double; an engine double that also declares `insertOne` stays in scope; a mixed fixture reports exactly the engine double.

## Acceptance notes

- `insertMany` stays in both `ENGINE_SIBLINGS` and `ENGINE_ONLY_MEMBERS`, deliberately (engine member, measured above).
- A native fake that declares none of the ten names (for example only `insertMany` + `find` + `findOne`) is still discovered. That is the A/B control, and the restored test needs `insertOne`/`updateOne` anyway; widening further is a `--census` measurement, not part of this card.
